suggestions: loop spec always clears failures and sets status to spec_locked, even when the spec hashes are unchanged, so the three-strike counter can be reset without a test change.
write_state rewrites every task file from the snapshot loaded at start, so two overlapping gate runs clobber each other despite the per-task state files.

check_clean ignores the whole .loop/ tree, while its comment says only .loop/runs/. A check can drop .loop/state/<other-task>.json after the scope check and still pass. mark allows any added or modified path under .loop/, not only LOOP_LAYOUT.

Run checks in a clean checkout of HEAD, or re-run scope and clean after checks and limit the .loop exemption to this run's evidence directory. Gitignored files and .git/info/exclude can currently change results without failing the clean check.
stream() never parses a final NDJSON line that lacks a trailing newline, and if the process stays quiet after a result event the idle timeout discards that verdict as review_infra.
remote_tag ignores a non-zero ls-remote status and has no timeout. A missing origin tag becomes '', which check_spec treats as a mismatch, so any repo with origin cannot gate offline.
T4 allowed contains e2e/*, which overlaps T3's locked spec (e2e/flow.spec.ts and the other e2e spec files). T4's spec check does not cover those paths.

Add tests for a changed failure signature staying repair, for --skip-review never passing, and for mark rejecting a PR head that differs outside .loop/. test_uncommitted_rename_out_of_loop_dir_is_rejected also passes because the committed .loop/note.txt is already outside LOOP_LAYOUT.
check_spec still uses git diff --name-only and str.split(), so a spec path containing a space would be parsed wrong. Use -z, as changed_files already does.

Sanitize the reviewer worktree with an explicit directory walk so names like .cursor and AGENTS.md are removed even if Path.rglob('*') skips hidden entries. write_state should create the temp file with O_EXCL and refuse to follow a symlink at *.tmp.
